subject: Vendor portal invite failing due to email subaddress sanitization
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@solarpatch.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble accepting vendor invite

Hi Chloe,

We received the supplier portal invite this morning but when I click the accept link it throws a short error and loops me back to the login page. The link UI shows our address as sara+vendors@solarpatch.com — we use plus-addressing for inbox rules. I can share a screenshot.

Error text: "Activation failed — account claim conflict (403)."

Can you help or resend a one-time link? We need to get set up so PO approvals can start.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kline
Head of Procurement
SolarPatch Inc.
Phone: +1 415 555 0198
From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting vendor invite

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick note and screenshot offer.

A couple of notes and quick asks so we can triage:
- Can you attach the screenshot of the browser when the error happens (the full page with URL)?
- Which browser and OS are you on? (Safari/Chrome/Edge + macOS/Win)
- Does the link redirect you to an SSO page first (company IDP) or straight to our activation flow?

We have seen a small number of gateways normalize subaddressing (strip the +suffix) which can cause a tenant-claim mismatch if the same base email is already registered elsewhere. If that’s what’s happening we can either: (1) generate a one-time activation link that bypasses the tenant-claim check, or (2) ask you to confirm an alternate contact address temporarily.

Ben — FYI this looks like the subaddress/claim collision pattern we handled last quarter. Rafael — can you check whether the invite token includes the claim param and whether regen will set a one-time override?

I’ll hold here until I get the screenshot.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Vendor Onboarding Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting vendor invite

Chloe — quick update from infra: we can issue a single-use activation token that matches the invite and ignores a pre-existing claim for the base address for 24 hours. Steps: (a) regen a token with override=true, (b) mark the invite in HubSpot (HP-4567) with the override flag, (c) send the regen link in the body (not as an attachment).

If we see frequent failures for +addressing from the same domain we should add a workflow to normalize or explicitly accept common subaddress forms, but that's product/engineering work. For now, Rafael, please create the one-time token and send me the URL so I can QC before we send to SolarPatch.

Ben
From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@solarpatch.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting vendor invite

Hi Chloe — attaching the screenshots you asked for.

We tested on Chrome (MacOS 12.4) and Edge (Windows 10). Both show the same flow: click -> redirect to https://supplier.redwood.example/accept?token=xxx -> immediate 403 with message "account claim conflict" and a button that reads "Back to login" which just sends us to the portal signin.

Attachment: screenshot-invite-error.png (image/png)
Attachment: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (application/pdf) — completed vendor profile (contact details + W9).

If you can resend the one-time link that would be ideal. Otherwise, we can provide an alternate contact: sara.kline.alt@solarpatch.com (temporary).

Appreciate the help — we have a PO pending and want to avoid delays.

Regards,
Sara
From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@solarpatch.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 12:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting vendor invite

Thanks — received the attachments and screenshot. Rafael generated the single-use override token and I validated the link (https://supplier.redwood.example/accept?onetimetoken=ONETIMETOKEN-abc). I just sent the token to Sara directly, not as an attachment, and updated HubSpot (HP-4567) with the note: "Sent one-time override token due to subaddress normalization on solarpatch domain. Expires 2027-04-14T12:32:00-07:00."

Next steps / action items:
- SolarPatch to click the new link and complete the onboarding form (they attached a filled form — we uploaded to the vendor record).
- Ben / Rafael to file an ops ticket to document the subaddress normalization case and propose a product story for a longer-term fix.
- Chloe to confirm PO visibility after SolarPatch finishes the onboarding flow.

Sara — please reply here when the acceptance completes or if the one-time link hits anything unexpected. If it fails again we will escalate to the backend team immediately.

Best,
Chloe
